title: Set Up Project Infrastructure and Authentication
description: Initialize the Next.js 14 project with required libraries, configure Clerk authentication, and establish environment-based API key management for secure server-side operations.
details:
- Initialize a Next.js 14 project with App Router and TypeScript.
- Install and configure Clerk for user sign-up, sign-in, and session management.
- Set up Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Framer Motion, and Lucide React for UI/UX.
- Configure environment variables for JinaAI and OpenAI API keys, ensuring they are only accessible server-side.
- Prepare Vercel deployment pipeline with environment variable support.
- Ensure HTTPS enforcement and basic folder structure for maintainability.
test_strategy:
- Verify Clerk authentication flow (sign-up, sign-in, session persistence, protected routes).
- Confirm environment variables are not exposed client-side.
- Deploy to Vercel and test environment variable access and HTTPS enforcement.
- Check UI loads with all dependencies and libraries initialized.

title: Implement URL Submission and Validation UI
description: Develop the main analyzer page with a single URL submission form using React Hook Form and Zod for real-time validation and error handling.
details:
- Create a protected analyzer page accessible only to authenticated users.
- Implement a form with an input for webpage URL and a submit button.
- Use React Hook Form and Zod for real-time validation (including inline error messages for empty/invalid URLs).
- Add Framer Motion loading spinner for feedback during analysis.
- Ensure accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) and responsive design (mobile-first).
test_strategy:
- Test form validation for various URL inputs (valid, invalid, empty).
- Confirm error messages display as expected.
- Check loading spinner appears during analysis.
- Validate accessibility and responsiveness across devices.

title: Develop Server-Side Analysis API Route
description: Create the Next.js API route `/api/analyze` to securely fetch webpage content using JinaAI, analyze it with OpenAI, and return a Markdown report.
details:
- Implement `/api/analyze` as a server-side API route in Next.js.
- Use `getWebsiteContent(url)` helper in `lib/analyze.ts` to fetch HTML/text from JinaAI.
- Use `analyzeContent(text)` helper to send content to OpenAI and receive analysis.
- Sanitize Markdown output using DOMPurify to prevent XSS.
- Add error handling, retry logic (up to 2 retries with exponential backoff), and rate limiting.
- Ensure API keys are never exposed to the client.
test_strategy:
- Mock and test API route with various URLs (valid, invalid, large content).
- Simulate API failures to test retry and error handling.
- Confirm Markdown output is sanitized and secure.
- Check rate limiting and response times (≤10s for 90th percentile).

title: Build Report Rendering, Download, and Local Persistence
description: Implement client-side logic to render Markdown analysis, enable report download as .md files, and persist past reports in localStorage.
details:
- Use the `marked` library to render Markdown returned from the API as sanitized HTML.
- Provide a "Download .md" button to save the report locally.
- Implement a custom `useLocalStorage` hook to store and retrieve past reports.
- Display past reports below the current result, with UI for selection.
- Handle localStorage limits (warn/prune as needed).
- Ensure UI is responsive and accessible.
test_strategy:
- Test Markdown rendering for various report contents.
- Verify download functionality produces correct .md files.
- Add, retrieve, and delete reports from localStorage; test storage limits.
- Confirm UI updates as expected when reports are added or removed.

title: Implement Error Handling, Notifications, and Security Measures
description: Add inline form errors, toast notifications for network/AI failures, and enforce security best practices across the app.
details:
- Integrate toast notifications for network errors, AI API failures, and storage issues.
- Ensure all form and API errors are surfaced to the user in a clear, actionable way.
- Sanitize all user-facing HTML (especially Markdown output).
- Enforce HTTPS and check for secure handling of API keys and sensitive data.
- Add JSDoc comments and maintain modular folder structure for maintainability.
test_strategy:
- Simulate network/API failures and verify user notifications.
- Test for XSS and other injection vulnerabilities in rendered Markdown.
- Review codebase for security best practices and documentation coverage.
- Confirm all error states are handled gracefully in the UI.
